Definition: Tsochar, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Zohar is the name of two men, a Hittite father of Ephron and a son of Simeon. In Genesis 23:8, intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar. The fuller story is told on the Zohar, Son of Simeon profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zohar belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
